_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV REIT mall : Real Estate FFO/share (KPI maitre REIT), Occupancy (qualite portfolio), Base Rent psf (pricing power), Total Revenue (top line), FFO total (cash flow), DPS (income investors).

kpis.signal: KPI maitre REIT, hausse continue +3.9% FY24, pricing power confirme
kpis.description_fr: Real Estate FFO par action diluee (core REIT KPI hors gains/pertes platform investments). 12.24$ FY24 vs 11.78$ FY23 (+3.9%). Indicateur de cash flow recurrent immobilier.
kpis.description_en: Real Estate FFO per diluted share (core REIT KPI excluding platform investments gains/losses). $12.24 FY24 vs $11.78 FY23 (+3.9%). Recurring real estate cash flow indicator.

kpis.name_en: US Malls & Premium Outlets Ending Occupancy
kpis.signal: Plus haut depuis pre-COVID, demande locative forte malgre concurrence e-commerce
kpis.description_fr: Taux d'occupation fin de periode portfolio US Malls + Premium Outlets (% GLA loue). 96.5% fin 2024 vs 95.8% (+70bps), plus haut depuis pre-COVID. Demande locative forte.
kpis.description_en: Ending occupancy US Malls + Premium Outlets portfolio (% GLA leased). 96.5% end 2024 vs 95.8% (+70bps), highest since pre-COVID. Strong leasing demand.

kpis.name_fr: Loyer minimum moyen par pied carre
kpis.name_en: Average Base Minimum Rent per Square Foot
kpis.signal: Pricing power class-A malls, hausse continue +2.5%/an, TRG a 68.06$ (+4.7%)
kpis.description_fr: Loyer minimum moyen par pied carre portfolio US Malls + Premium Outlets. 58.26 $/sq ft FY24 (+2.5%). TRG (Taubman class A+) a 68.06 $/sq ft. Pricing power confirme.
kpis.description_en: Average base minimum rent per sq ft US Malls + Premium Outlets portfolio. $58.26/sq ft FY24 (+2.5%). TRG (Taubman class A+) at $68.06/sq ft. Confirmed pricing power.

kpis.signal: Recovery post-COVID complet, croissance soutenue, +5.4% FY24
kpis.description_fr: CA consolide Simon Property (lease income + management + autres). 5.96 Mds$ FY24 (+5.4%). Recovery post-COVID complete, croissance soutenue par occupancy + base rent psf.
kpis.description_en: Simon Property consolidated revenue (lease income + management + other). $5.96B FY24 (+5.4%). Full post-COVID recovery, growth driven by occupancy + base rent psf.

kpis.signal: Cash flow recurrent immobilier, hausse continue, finance dividende + buybacks + investissements
kpis.description_fr: Real Estate FFO total (cash flow immobilier core REIT). 4.60 Mds$ FY24 (+4.3%). Finance le dividende (8.10$/action), buybacks et acquisitions (TRG, Klepierre, JC Penney).
kpis.description_en: Real Estate FFO total (core REIT real estate cash flow). $4.60B FY24 (+4.3%). Funds dividend ($8.10/share), buybacks and acquisitions (TRG, Klepierre, JC Penney).

kpis.signal: Hausse continue +8.7% FY24, payout sustainable (~66% Real Estate FFO/share), 99.4% taxable ordinary
kpis.description_fr: Dividende par action Simon Property (REIT, 90%+ income paye obligatoire). 8.10$ FY24 (+8.7%), payout ratio ~66% Real Estate FFO/share. 99.4% taxable comme revenu ordinaire.
kpis.description_en: Simon Property dividend per share (REIT, 90%+ income payout required). $8.10 FY24 (+8.7%), payout ratio ~66% Real Estate FFO/share. 99.4% taxable as ordinary income.
